title: A/P Summary: the vendor name header reverses on its first click
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role).
  • Have three vendors with open bills on today's date: vendor A, vendor B and vendor C; in name order they read vendor A, vendor B, vendor C.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide.
  • Open A/P Summary (Reports, then "A/P Aging Summary" under ACCOUNTS PAYABLE in the left menu).
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the header of the vendor name column (the first column).
  2. Click the header of the vendor name column (the first column) again.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The list was already sorted by name, so this first click reverses it: Z to A, vendor C above vendor B above vendor A.

Step 2:

  • Back to A to Z: vendor A, vendor B, vendor C.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 9 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 26 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11532 (Story 2, Sort by clicking any column header)

  • S2-R1, A/R Summary and A/P Summary columns: “A/R Summary and A/P Summary: the name column, Location (when shown), Current, 1-30 Days, 31-60 Days, 61-90 Days, 91 And Over, Total.”
  • S2-R1: “Every column on all six reports sorts when its header is clicked, except A/P Unpaid Invoices' Vendor Name column (S2-N1). The columns are:”
  • S2-R2: “The first click gives the useful order for the kind of data: text (names, Location, Transaction Type) A to Z; money columns largest first; dates oldest first; Past Due largest first; ID and No. smallest number first (S2-R4). The second click reverses it. The third click repeats the first; there is no unsorted state.”
  • S2-R3: “A header that is already the sorted column reverses on its first click.”
